verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a limited public API with OAuth 2 and PKCE that supports appending to notes and listing bookmarks, but nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, so there is also no machine-readable surface from which SDKs could be generated. A raw REST API is not an official SDK, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.
